item.title: RENOSTERBOS CABIN
item.description: Renosterbos Cabin is a private off grid retreat tucked between acacia trees on a nature reserve in Bonnievale, about two and a half hours from Cape Town. Zebra, eland and wildebeest roam the surrounding landscape, creating the kind of setting where luxury and wilderness sit comfortably side by side. item.description: PYRO Smokeless Fire Pit & Grill is designed to fix the biggest problem with outdoor fires: smoke.
